description: Turns Stripe's test mode on or off for the app's pre. On (the default): testers buy with Stripe's test cards and nothing is charged. Pre always sells the app's own products (one catalogue); in test mode it also lists the ones not published yet. Test purchases are marked as such: pro never counts them, not even when pre plays with pro's data (neblla_pre_data), and there they give no credits. Off: pre charges real money on the payout account. Returns the same state as neblla_pre_stripe_test_read.

on.description: true: test mode; false: real charges

name: neblla_pre_stripe_test
title: Pre stripe test
